sentences.text: Charts also show where the rules change, usually in magenta.
In a special anchorage area, remember, small vessels can anchor without an anchor light under the Inland rules.
Anchor, or drag any gear along the bottom.
Restricted areas, danger zones and security zones each have their own rules, explained in the chart notes and the Coast Pilot.
Bridges are shown with their type and two clearances: horizontal, the width between the piers, and vertical, the height.
And landmarks: tanks, towers, stacks, spires.
They’re there for you to take bearings on.
A small circle with a dot marks the exact position.
Capital letters mean the landmark is conspicuous.
